purpose: Determine whether the exact Module 1 and Module 2 inputs can support patient-linked breast cancer fusion.
module1_image_input: BUSI ultrasound image uploaded by the user
required_ground_truth: Reliable patient/lesion-level benign or malignant outcome

BrEaST_TCIA.reason: BrEaST's case-linked clinical schema does not contain four of Module 2's five required input fields. Its different fields cannot be substituted.

Module2_METABRIC.reason: METABRIC identifiers are not a verified key to BUSI image filenames or BrEaST CaseID.

public_candidate_review.published_metadata: 927 ultrasound images, benign/malignant cases, patient information XLSX, CC BY 4.0
public_candidate_review.decision: Not used. Publicly inspectable metadata does not establish complete field-level compatibility and per-image patient mapping.

public_candidate_review.published_cohort: 384 lesions from 379 cancer patients; age, lesion size, ER, PR, HER2 and ultrasound images reported
public_candidate_review.decision: Not used. The described cohort contains pathologically confirmed cancer patients for HER2 classification; it is not a publicly verified benign/malignant fusion dataset matching Module 2 inputs.

conclusion: No genuinely patient-linked dataset matching the exact Module 1 image input, all five Module 2 features, and benign/malignant ground truth has been verified in the local project or inspected public dataset descriptions.
safety_action: Module 3 runs Modules 1 and 2 inference independently and returns fusion unavailable; it does not generate a combined prediction or score.
